review.notes: All 27 physical pages compared against the OCR Markdown with a normalized full-text diff (case/punctuation-insensitive, LaTeX-equivalent math accepted); the only dropped runs were figure-internal labels (Figure 1 banner text on p.2 and PSNR axis ticks on p.12), which the embedded figures already show. No unbalanced code fences (0 fence blocks). Pages 2, 4, 6, 7 and 20 were additionally rendered to visually verify the five patches below, including both equation restorations and the dropped Appendix heading.

patches.evidence: Rendered physical p.2 shows this string only as the italic banner inside the Figure 1 overview image (together with figure-internal labels like 'Proprioceptive State Expert' and 'Deriving Reward from Video'); the paper title on p.1 and section headings use different wording. The OCR promoted the figure banner to a top-level heading, which duplicates the document outline; demoted to plain text per figure-banner rule.

patches.before: \left[ \begin{array}{c c c} \mathbf {z} _ {\text { noisy }}; & \mathbf {R} _ {\text { ray }}; & \mathbf {M} _ {\text { pose }};   \mathbf {m} _ {\text { cond }} \end{array} \right]
patches.evidence: Rendered physical p.6 equation (7) prints z_cond = [z_noisy; R_ray; M_pose; m_cond] as a plain bracketed list with semicolons and no column alignment. The OCR array declares 3 columns for 4 cells, so the renderer would wrap the last cell onto a second row; the wrapper is removed and the printed separators kept.

Rendered physical p.7 equation (9) prints s_t = [theta_t^L, g_t^L, theta_t^R, g_t^R] in R^16 as a plain bracketed list (visually verified at 300 dpi). Same 3-column/4-cell OCR array defect as equation (7), and the exponent digits of 16 are spaced in the OCR but printed tight in the PDF.
Rendered physical p.4 equation (4) prints the control action as belonging to R^14 with the exponent '14' tight (visually verified at 300 dpi); OCR spaced the two digits.

Rendered physical p.20 prints a numbered section heading '8 Appendix' (blue, same style as other section headings) directly above '8.1 Memory-Frame Augmentation Details'; the OCR dropped the parent heading, leaving appendix subsections 8.1-8.4 orphaned after References. The heading text was re-inserted from the printed page.

unresolved.evidence: Figure 1 banner sub-labels on p.2 (e.g. 'Proprioceptive State Expert', reward values 0.034/0.233/0.090/0.653) and PSNR/SSIM axis ticks with bin labels (1-10 ... 41-50, 'Time range (seconds)') on p.12 are interleaved into the OCR text; they exist only inside the embedded figure images, which show them, so no text repair applies.
